QuestInfo.name: A Marble Made With Care
QuestInfo.0: #p204# of #m10001000# seems to have finished the birthday present for #p218#.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p204##k asked me to deliver the birthday present to #b#p218##k on her behalf. Since it isn't the exact item #p218# said she wanted, #p204# seems quite worried about it. Still, it must've just been my imagination that #p218# seemed to be thinking about #p225#. \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 37 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I delivered #p204#'s birthday present to #p218#. Now that she's received it, #p218# seems somehow flustered.

0.0: Did I keep you waiting long? I finally finished the #b#t4031121##k for #p218#. The #t4000029# was so sturdy that I ruined quite a few tries, but I managed to salvage just the one. Here, take a look. Isn't it wonderfully unique and pretty?
0.1: I think this marble suits #p218# even better, but it isn't the one she said she wanted, so I'm a little worried. I do hope she likes it...
0.2: So, would you mind delivering this to #p218# for me? Honestly, I could never have made this without you, #h0#, so I like to think of it as a birthday present the two of us are giving #p218# together.

yes.0: Thank you so much! Please be sure to deliver the #b#t4031121##k safely to #p218#. Do be careful not to lose it!

no.0: I never expected you to turn me down...

1.0: Huh? I didn't expect you to come back. #p204# wants to give me this #b#t4031121##k as my birthday present, is that it? This... for me...?

npc.0: Please be sure to deliver the #b#t4031121##k I gave you to #p218#. Please, I'm counting on you!

lost.0: Don't tell me you've gone and lost the #t4031121# I worked so hard to make? Whew... good thing I kept one aside just in case... Please, do be more careful this time.
